name: Parallel HDF5
description: Builds HDF5 2.2.0 into /opt/wise with MPI-IO (parallel), C, Fortran and zlib. On the CUDA base image it also builds an nvfortran copy into /opt/wise/nvhpc, since Fortran modules are compiler specific. Provider of LAMMPS H5MD and the HDF5 output of Quantum ESPRESSO and CP2K.
